ns2:course.label: Contemp Issues in Ind Country
ns2:course.description: Surveys a variety of topics in contemporary American Indian life. Focusing on the modern experience, topics may include law and politics; lands and environment; education; visual arts; languages and literatures; health; social justice; business; treaties; the sacred; gender; sports; decolonization; comparative tribal, Indian and global indigenous concerns.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: UIUC Social Sciences, and US Minority Culture(s) course.
